tools.falsifier:
REFUTED IF: a turn lands a write (an `activity`-carrying call) AND suspends on a card, and the message the author reads does NOT name what landed. That is the defect, live.

CONFIRMED IF: the same turn's text carries the platform's own account -- "Nothing has been saved yet; confirm the card above to apply it. Already applied in this turn: glossary_propose_entities."

🔴 AND THE WRITE MUST BE A REAL ONE. A call returning `created: false` committed nothing and must NOT be named; that is not a weaker bar but a stricter one, and it cost this scenario its first positive.

🔴 A CLEAN ARM THAT NEVER LANDS A WRITE PROVES NOTHING HERE, and it is the likely failure of this scenario rather than a finding: if the turn cards before anything writes, the positive case was never exercised and the run must be recorded as not reaching the path -- exactly what happened to c-kgedge-nodes and to the two gbuild arms on 2026-08-31.
